semantics:
- main:
  - heading "Title" [level=1]
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "a b":
        - columnheader "a"
        - columnheader "b"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "x y":
        - cell "x"
        - cell "y"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "Completed task" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: done
  - paragraph: <script>globalThis.attacked=true</script>
  - paragraph: alt
note: Real Chromium correctness and accessibility-tree smoke test under CSP + Trusted Types; no browser performance comparison.
